id.description: The unique identifier for the uploaded file

filename.description: The original filename of the uploaded file

file_url.description: The WebSim storage URL for the uploaded file

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes

content_type.description: The MIME type of the uploaded file

uploader_username.description: The username of the user who uploaded the file

upload_date.description: The date and time when the file was uploaded

database.instructions: This database stores metadata about files uploaded through the WebSim File Upload Hub. Files are stored using the WebSim upload API and this database tracks the metadata. Users can view and manage their uploaded files through the dashboard.
